summary: Quik's Quality Potatoes is a family-owned company in Hedel, Netherlands, that washes, sorts and packs fresh potatoes. Since 2001 it has also made chilled, ready-to-cook potato products such as pre-fried fresh fries, mashed potatoes and baby potatoes. Hendrik Quik started the potato trade in 1932.
products: Washed, sorted and packed fresh table potatoes
Pre-fried fresh fries, including RustiQue fries with skin
Baby potatoes with rosemary and sea salt
markets: Foodservice: hospitality, catering and large-scale kitchens
Customers in the Netherlands and abroad
facts: 1932: Hendrik Quik starts the potato trade
2001: starts processing potatoes into ready-to-cook products
2015: fresh potato and potato products divisions brought together as Quik's Quality Potatoes
RustiQue fries sold in packs from 700 g to 5 kg, pre-fried in 100% sunflower oil
SBTi-validated target: scope 1 and 2 emissions down 63% (absolute) by 2035, base year 2024
